steps.db: select sum(kind = 'sales_photo') as photos, sum(kind = 'sales_document') as docs, (select payee_extraction_status from purchase_listings where vehicle_number = ? and deleted_at is null) as ext from inspection_photos where purchase_listing_id = (select id from purchase_listings where vehicle_number = ? and deleted_at is null)
select status, car_erp_vehicle_id, buyer_undecided, car_erp_buyer_id, sale_price, offer_currency, selling_fee, owner_name from purchase_listings where vehicle_number = ? and deleted_at is null
